name: volthub-csms
description: VoltHub CSMS — two-engine EV charging management (Oracle OLTP + TimescaleDB telemetry, OCPP 1.6J simulator)

scripts.test: node apps/worker/test/relay.test.js && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/simulator && node apps/api/test/security.js && node apps/api/test/xlayer.js && node apps/api/test/ocpp-remote.js && node apps/api/test/gateway-close.js && node test/sql/run-invariants.js && node scripts/check-openapi.js
scripts.test:load: command -v k6 >/dev/null && k6 run test/load/k6-smoke.js || echo 'k6 not installed — skipping load (install k6 to run NFR-03/04 gates)'
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:race -w apps/api && npm run test:e2e
